blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — While forgoing the cross examination of defense witnesses is a way to expedite Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, the prosecution panel is not fully sold on the idea yet since some of the points that supposedly strengthened their case came through this step. In a press briefing on Monday, prosecution panel spokesperson and former Surigao del Norte Rep. Robert Ace Barbers was asked if he agrees with views made by lead public prosecutor and Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro — that one way to expedite the trial is by no longer submitting witnesses presented by Duterte’s lawyers to […]...
